name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.23
body:
**File Transfer**
- a new faster http method is used for file transfers vs websockets. websockets is now used for control plane only.

**Experimental Firmware stage/update**
- "Copy FPGA firmware" and "Copy updater" steps are now even faster because of the reasoning above. 
  - firmware stage + update now only takes 45 seconds.

**Misc**
- gameID / Settings tab preloads in background upon opening DonutShop.
- removed "Bridge FIFO now" from DonutShop stats. only Bridge FIFO peak is useful.
- Last reset and Uptime now added to DonutShop Memory stats.
- WebCtl is now labeled "RT WebCtl" until either a RT4K or RT6X has been detected; then labels itself as RT4K WebCtl or RT6X WebCtl.
- tabs selected to show in Options no longer disappear / reappear when sleeping / waking.
